generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the simulator in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with build config in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It parses RS274 blocks, executes modal state and motion, reads tool/parameter files, writes the required end-state JSON, and emits trace JSON with stepped sampling.

It builds with `cmake -B build -S output && cmake --build build`. I also verified the build and exercised it against a basic linear-motion trace case and an error case (`G43 H99`) to confirm JSON output, trace writing, and exit codes.

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
